title: Open Oldenburg Conversation Corpus (OOCC): A Corpus of Audio, Video and Body Pose Data in Dyadic Conversations in German
why_promising: Primary non-singing German dyadic-conversation recordings with synchronized audio/video/body-pose data. Zenodo version 2 exposes separate transcript and landmark archives for both 2-minute and 10-minute recordings, plus metadata/documentation. The deposit is open under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with explicit participant-protection conditions and requests that substantial portions not be redistributed outside the official repository. Version 2 is treated as the current lineage rather than duplicating version 1.
open_question: Before core promotion, inspect documentation and transcript/landmark archives to establish which transcript boundaries, landmarks, or labels were manually created/corrected or exhaustively human-verified versus automatically generated. Ingest only qualifying human-created layers. Preserve authoritative Zenodo URLs/checksums instead of mirroring restricted-by-condition media or substantial corpus portions; enumerate participant/task metadata and isolate any automatic pose/landmark outputs from human annotations.
